LanguageData.TM_Resurrection.description: Resurrection restores the life of a recently deceased pawn. This places an immense demand on the Priest and resurrected pawn and both will be weak for several days while their strength recovers. Resurrection comes at a price; the resurrected pawn will forfeit up to 35% of their skills and may develop detrimental health conditions.
LanguageData.TM_Resurrection.label: Resurrection
